scheme_name: Coaching Assistance to Scheduled Castes Students for Preparation of Examination Like IIM, NIFT, NLU, CEPT
other_conditions: Students must have secured 70% or more in Class 10th and be studying in Class 12th (any stream) to be eligible for CEPT, NIFT, or NLU admissions.

Students must have secured 70% or more in Class 12th (any stream) and be in the third year of graduation (any stream) or have secured 70% or more marks in a completed graduation to be eligible for IIM admissions.

Training institutes must have more than three years of experience, possess a GST Number or PAN card, have biometric (fingerprint) machines for student attendance, and be registered under any one of the following Acts: Mumbai Public Trust Act, 1950; Companies Act, 1956; Shop and Establishment Act, 1948 (Shops and Institutions Act, 1948).
benefits_summary: Up to ₹20,000 or the actual coaching fee, whichever is lower.
